name: Trans-Union Interstate Pipeline
researcher_notes: No existing row matches by name, endpoints or length in the 529-row US gas roster. The nearest rows are the Regency intrastate system rows, which are a different pipeline that this line connects to. A Federal Register notice from February 2000 for FERC docket CP00-47 says the company applied in December 1999 to build 41.7 miles of 30-inch pipe from the Sharon Hub in Claiborne Parish, Louisiana to the Union Power Partners plant in Union County, Arkansas, for 430,000 Dth per day. The EIA pipeline projects table for August 2026, sheet Historical Projects 1996-2024, Excel row 207, lists it as Completed with an in-service date of 30 October 2001, 41.7 miles, 30 inches, 427 MMcf/d, and 45 million dollars cost. Both are federal sources. A Rextag page from January 2024 gives about 42 miles, with owner Black Bear Transmission LLC and operator BBT Trans-Union Interstate Pipeline LP. It also names Texas Gas Transmission and Regency as connections and El Dorado Chemical as a customer. Rextag is an unofficial posting, so the owner above is the 2000 applicant, and the current parent was not confirmed. The end point of El Dorado comes from the candidate note and Rextag, not the Federal Register notice. Length is 67 km, above the 25 km threshold. No route was researched, so RouteType and RouteAccuracy are left blank. Confidence is high. The EIA table and the Federal Register notice are separate publishers.
